title: Alexander S Probable NDE 8402
content: I was downtown Denver and came across a dude who thought I stole his skateboard. I told him I just got into Denver. He still kept accusing me of stealing his skateboard. I was homeless at the time, so I got up and he was walking away. I started to run away and he started chasing after me in downtown Denver. As we were running, he got ahold of my shirt and ripped it off of me. I ended up losing my backpack with all my stuff in it. We ran through alley-way. Then we were outside of a hotel. I was yelling, 'Help! Help! Somebody help! while the dude just kept throwing punches. A black dude came up and tried to intervene, saying 'Hey! Stop! Get off of him!' Then my attacker pulled out a knife. I was thinking, 'Oh shoot! I'm going to die right here!' I was somehow able to hit him in the head, which distracted him briefly. He then went full crazy on me and I got knocked out when my head hit the ground. I saw a very bright light almost like at the end of a tunnel. It made me so warm and happy. I could just the see clouds and then I heard voices in the background. I was blacked out for maybe a good 20 minutes. I fully woke up at around 5 in the morning in the hospital with IVs in my body. At the time, I didn't know what they were start so I was pulling them out. They let me go. I left the hospital and tried to understrand what happened the night before. I felt so alive and like I had a better purpose in life. The experience was like a wake-up call. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: September NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Criminal attack Direct head injury. Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant The experience included: Out of body experience Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I heard paramedics, ambulances, then it was a bitter silence. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. Yes. I felt like I was out of my body. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I blacked out and woke up in a hospital bed. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. It was like it never happened. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Before this experience, everything felt dull and bland. I didn't have a purpose in life and then I ended up having this NDE. It will completely opened up my eyes to the world and what actually lies around in it. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I can hear better than I did when I did not have the NDE. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? Yes, and the facts have been checked out The experience included: Passing into or through a tunnel Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes It was completely black and then there was a very bright light like brighter than I've ever seen. It was just bright. Did you see any beings in your experience? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an Unearthly light? Yes It was a tunnel with a bright light. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. I saw a bright light with a gate and clouds. The experience included: Strong emotional tone What emotions did you feel during the experience? I was cold, warm, very happy, it was dark but there was a light at the end of the tunnel. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature The experience included: Special knowledge or purpose Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe. It opened my eyes to things other people would take for granted. Did scenes from your past come back to you? No The experience included: Future Visions Did scenes from the future come to you? Scenes from my personal future. I left all my worries and fears back on earth Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion: What importance did you place on your religious/spiritual life prior to your experience? Moderately important to me What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Protestant Baptist Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes God Lives. What importance do you place on your religious/spiritual life after your experience? Greatly important to me What is your religion now? Christian- Protestant Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I believe there is a Heaven and hell. I saw Heaven for a slight second. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I know that I was out of this world for a godly purpose. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes Bright tunnel with clouds and a gate. Did you believe in the existence of God prior to your experience? God probably exists During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes It was complete Darkness, but there was a tunnel with a light. I heard a voice but couldn't make it out. Do you believe in the existence of God after your experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I know that this isn't our last life. Did you believe that our earthly lives Are meaningful and significant prior to your experience? Are probably meaningful and significant During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes Don't take life for granted. This was a wake-up call for me. Did you believe in an afterlife prior to your experience? An afterlife probably exists Do you believe in an afterlife after your experience? An afterlife definitely exists. Yes There is another life-form out there. It's for everybody if you choose to live for Christ. Did you fear death prior to your experience? I moderately feared death Do you fear death after your experience? I do not fear death Were you fearful living your life prior to your experience? Moderately fearful in living my earthly life Were you fearful living your life after your experience? Not fearful in living my earthly life Did you believe that our earthly lives Are meaningful and significant prior to your experience? Are probably meaningful and significant Did you believe that our earthly lives are meaningful and significant after your experience? Are meaningful and significant Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No Were you compassionate prior to your experience? Moderately compassionate toward others During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I felt like there was just an uplifting love presence. Were you compassionate after your experience? Greatly compassionate toward others What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life I need to serve God. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes Everybody sees me as good. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. It was cold and dark. There was a very bright light and I felt unending love and joy. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I told Family, close friends and coworkers. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I needed to open up my eyes. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. It is very real. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes Yes I know that God is near and heals anyone. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I have found peace. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Nope, this was very straight forward.
